name: 19426 · Collegeville, PA
findings: ZIP 19426 (Collegeville) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19426 (Collegeville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19426 (Collegeville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
